name: Chikan wa Yamete
source:
It is a game to play pranks on a girl who goes by the same train every day. Select the mischief to play, and game will proceed accordingly.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将对每天搭乘同一班电车的女孩恶作剧。选择要采取的举动，剧情便会随之发展。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
